description: Wrap functional components in React.memo to prevent rerenders when props unchanged
code_hint: export default React.memo(MyComponent)
anti_pattern: Wrapping every component in memo without profiling first - memo has overhead

description: Memoize expensive computed values that don't need to recalculate on every render
code_hint: const sorted = useMemo(() => items.sort(fn) [items])
anti_pattern: Wrapping every value in useMemo - only use for genuinely expensive operations

description: Stabilize function references passed as props to memoized child components
code_hint: const handler = useCallback(() => doThing(id) [id])
anti_pattern: Using useCallback everywhere without memoized children - no benefit without memo

keywords: lazy suspense dynamic import bundle splitting
description: Split route components for smaller initial bundle with automatic code splitting
code_hint: const Page = lazy(() => import('./Page')); wrap with Suspense + fallback
anti_pattern: Importing all page components at top level loading all code upfront

keywords: nextjs dynamic import ssr csr split
description: Next.js dynamic imports with optional SSR disable for client-only components
code_hint: const Map = dynamic(() => import('./Map') { ssr: false })
anti_pattern: Statically importing client-only libraries like Leaflet causing SSR errors

description: Use stable unique IDs as list keys not array indexes for correct reconciliation
code_hint: key={item.id} not key={index}
anti_pattern: Using array index as key in dynamic lists causing state bugs and poor performance

keywords: virtualize list rows virtual scroll performance
description: Use react-window or TanStack Virtual for lists with 50+ items
code_hint: import { FixedSizeList } from 'react-window'
anti_pattern: Rendering 500+ DOM nodes directly causing jank and memory issues

description: Keep state as local as possible; only lift when needed by multiple components
code_hint: Declare state in lowest common ancestor component only
anti_pattern: Putting all state in root App component causing entire tree rerenders

keywords: zustand jotai state management store global
description: Use atomic state management that only rerenders subscribed components
code_hint: const count = useAtom(countAtom) or useStore(state => state.count)
anti_pattern: Using Context for high-frequency state updates causing all consumers to rerender

keywords: usereducer complex state logic dispatch action
description: Use useReducer for complex state transitions with multiple related values
code_hint: const [state dispatch] = useReducer(reducer initialState)
anti_pattern: Using many useState calls for related state that changes together

description: Use next/image for automatic WebP conversion responsive images and lazy loading
code_hint: <Image src={url} width={800} height={600} alt="" />
anti_pattern: Using raw tag losing all optimization benefits in Next.js

keywords: lazy loading images below fold html
description: Native lazy loading for images below the fold
anti_pattern: Loading all images eagerly including those far below the fold

description: Use next/font for automatic font optimization zero layout shift
code_hint: import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'; const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'] })
anti_pattern: Loading fonts from Google CDN without optimization causing FOIT

keywords: react query swr cache stale data fetching
description: Use SWR or TanStack Query for declarative data fetching with built-in caching
code_hint: const { data } = useSWR('/api/user' fetcher) or useQuery({queryKey queryFn})
anti_pattern: Manual fetch in useEffect without caching causing waterfall and redundant requests

description: Use Next.js extended fetch with revalidate for ISR and cache control
code_hint: fetch(url { next: { revalidate: 60 } })
anti_pattern: Fetching same data on every request without any server-side caching

description: Defer non-urgent UI updates so urgent updates get priority
code_hint: const deferredQuery = useDeferredValue(query)
anti_pattern: Blocking high-priority renders with expensive filter/search operations

description: Mark state updates as non-urgent with startTransition for concurrent rendering
code_hint: const [isPending startTransition] = useTransition(); startTransition(() => setItems(filtered))
anti_pattern: Treating all state updates as equal priority causing input lag

keywords: server components nextjs rsc no js
description: Use React Server Components for data fetching - zero JS sent to client
code_hint: async function Page() { const data = await fetchData(); return <Component data={data} /> }
anti_pattern: Fetching data in client components when it could be done in server components

description: Stream HTML with Suspense boundaries for faster perceived performance
code_hint: Wrap lazy sections in <Suspense fallback={<Skeleton />}> in server components
anti_pattern: Block entire page render waiting for all data before sending any HTML

description: Fetch independent data in parallel not sequentially to avoid waterfall
code_hint: await Promise.all([fetchUser() fetchPosts()]) instead of sequential await
anti_pattern: await fetchUser(); await fetchPosts() - sequential requests double the wait time

description: Use named imports not default imports from libraries for better tree shaking
code_hint: import { format } from 'date-fns' not import dateFns from 'date-fns'
anti_pattern: Import entire library when you only need one function adding 100KB

description: Use @next/bundle-analyzer to identify large dependencies regularly
code_hint: Add ANALYZE=true to next.config.js with bundle analyzer setup
anti_pattern: Shipping large bundle without knowing what's inside it

keywords: lucide icons import size tree shaking
description: Import only needed icons not entire icon library
code_hint: import { Home Menu } from 'lucide-react'
anti_pattern: import * as Icons from 'lucide-react' loading 1000 icon SVGs

description: Use React Hook Form for uncontrolled inputs to avoid rerender on every keystroke
code_hint: const { register handleSubmit } = useForm(); <input {...register('email')} />
anti_pattern: Controlled inputs with useState for every field causing 100 rerenders per form

description: Use Zod for runtime schema validation with TypeScript inference
code_hint: const schema = z.object({ email: z.string().email() }); schema.parse(data)
anti_pattern: Manual if-statement validation for every field with inconsistent error messages

description: Use Next.js Metadata API for SEO meta tags and Open Graph
code_hint: export const metadata = { title: 'Page' description: 'Desc' }
anti_pattern: Hardcoding meta tags in HTML template without dynamic page-level overrides

description: Pre-render dynamic routes at build time with generateStaticParams
code_hint: export async function generateStaticParams() { return posts.map(p => ({ slug: p.slug })) }
anti_pattern: Skipping static generation for content that rarely changes

description: Use semantic HTML elements and ARIA roles for screen reader compatibility
code_hint: <button aria-label="Close menu"> not <div onClick={close}>
anti_pattern: Using div or span for interactive elements without role and keyboard support

description: Manage focus correctly in modals and dialogs; trap focus while open
code_hint: useFocusTrap(modalRef) move focus to modal on open restore on close
anti_pattern: Opening modal leaving focus on trigger; focus can escape modal

description: Wrap route/section components in ErrorBoundary to catch render errors gracefully
code_hint: class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component { componentDidCatch() render fallback }
anti_pattern: Letting unhandled errors crash the entire application

description: Extract reusable stateful logic into custom hooks for cleaner components
code_hint: function useWindowSize() { const [size] = useState(); useEffect... return size }
anti_pattern: Duplicating same useEffect + useState logic in 10 different components

description: Use compound component pattern for flexible composable UI components
code_hint: <Select><Select.Option>Item</Select.Option></Select>
anti_pattern: Passing 15 props to a single component for every configuration variation

description: Separate data fetching from presentation for testability and reuse
code_hint: DataContainer fetches and passes data to pure PresentationComponent
anti_pattern: Mixing API calls useEffect fetch logic directly inside JSX presentation components

description: Enable TypeScript strict mode to catch null/undefined bugs at compile time
code_hint: tsconfig: "strict": true
anti_pattern: Disabling strict mode to avoid fixing type errors - losing type safety value

description: Use discriminated unions for loading/success/error state management
code_hint: type State = { status: 'loading' } | { status: 'success' data: T } | { status: 'error' error: E }
anti_pattern: Using separate booleans: isLoading isError isSuccess that can be in impossible states

description: Prefetch routes on link hover for instant navigation feeling
code_hint: <Link href="/dashboard" prefetch>Dashboard</Link>
anti_pattern: Disabling prefetch on all links removing instant navigation behavior

description: Add loading.tsx files in Next.js for automatic loading state per route
code_hint: Create loading.tsx next to page.tsx with skeleton component
anti_pattern: No loading state showing blank screen during navigation

description: Use Next.js parallel routes for complex dashboard layouts with independent loading
code_hint: @analytics @notifications folders in app directory with separate loading states
anti_pattern: Rendering entire dashboard page waiting for slowest data fetch

keywords: optimistic update ui react query mutation
description: Update UI immediately then sync with server for snappy interactions
code_hint: useMutation({ onMutate: updateCacheOptimistically onError: rollback })
anti_pattern: Waiting for server response before updating UI making app feel slow

description: Move expensive computation off main thread to prevent UI jank
code_hint: const worker = new Worker('./worker.js'); worker.postMessage(data)
anti_pattern: Running CPU-intensive calculations synchronously blocking scroll and input

description: Use Next.js route groups (folder) for shared layouts without URL segment
code_hint: Create (auth) folder to share auth layout without adding /auth to URL
anti_pattern: Creating wrapper pages just to share layouts adding URL segments

keywords: ppr nextjs partial prerender static dynamic
description: Use Next.js PPR to serve static shell instantly and stream dynamic content
code_hint: Add experimental.ppr: true in next.config.js
anti_pattern: Full dynamic rendering for pages that are mostly static content

description: Use React DevTools Profiler to find actual rerender bottlenecks before optimizing
code_hint: Record a flame graph; look for components with many rerenders or long render time
anti_pattern: Guessing which components need memoization without profiling
